blurb: Louisiana Charter Boat Association connects anglers with experienced, licensed captains across Louisiana's freshwater, inshore, and offshore fisheries. Captains provide gear, tackle, boats, and expertise for guided fishing trips. Guests simply show up at the dock and the captain handles navigation, equipment, and finding fish.
